description: Analogue oscillator with five outputs, a wavefolder and a pulse wave that morphs between two shapes

params.text: Drops every output into low frequency range, topping out at 220Hz
Sets the fundamental frequency of the oscillator, and so the pitch of every output
Tunes the frequency finely around the setting of the COARSE knob
Sets the FM input to linear scaling on the left or exponential on the right, where a full attenuator gives roughly a volt per octave
Sets the depth of frequency modulation from the FM input
Sets the octave of the square output: two octaves down at the left, unison in the centre, one octave down at the right
Sets the width of the pulses at the PULSE output
Sets how far the oscillator's sine wave is folded, and attenuates the wavefold CV input when one is patched
Blends the PULSE output from a split triangle wave anticlockwise to a softened stepped triangle clockwise
Sets a DC offset on the sine wave before it is folded, which changes the harmonics of the FOLD output

inputs.text: Sets the pitch at a volt per octave, summed with the COARSE and FINE knobs
A rising edge above 2V flips the charge direction of the triangle core, locking the oscillator to integer multiples of the incoming frequency
Frequency modulation, scaled by the FM attenuator and applied linearly or exponentially by the LIN EXP toggle
Modulates the pulse width, -5V to 5V summed with the PWM knob
Unipolar positive control of the folding amount, attenuated by the FOLD knob

outputs.text: Square wave, at the octave set by the SUB toggle
Triangle wave at the oscillator's fundamental frequency
Sine wave at the oscillator's fundamental frequency
The pulse waveform, at the width set by PWM and the shape set by the crossfade knob
The oscillator's sine wave after the wavefolder, shaped by the FOLD knob and the symmetry bias

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
